import { Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Job } from 'bullmq';

enum ReportJob {
  Generate = 'generate-pdf',
  Archive = 'archive-pdf',
  Fail = 'fail-pdf',
}

@Injectable()
class ReportWorkService {
  async received(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async generate(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async archive(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async afterBreak(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async unmatched(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async finalize(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
}

// B0_CASE:switch-complete
@Processor('reports')
class SafeSwitchProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: ReportWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<{ readonly id: string }, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    // B0_BRANCH:common-prelude
    await this.work.received(job.data.id);
    try {
      switch (job.name) {
        // B0_BRANCH:exact-return
        case ReportJob.Generate: {
          await this.work.generate(job.data.id);
          return;
        }
        // B0_BRANCH:grouped-break
        case ReportJob.Archive:
        case 'archive-legacy': {
          await this.work.archive(job.data.id);
          break;
        }
        // B0_BRANCH:exact-throw
        case ReportJob.Fail: {
          throw new Error(`Report ${job.data.id} failed`);
        }
        // B0_BRANCH:default
        default: {
          await this.work.unmatched(job.data.id);
          return;
        }
      }
      await this.work.afterBreak(job.data.id);
    } finally {
      // B0_BRANCH:common-finally
      await this.work.finalize(job.data.id);
    }
  }
}

@Module({ providers: [ReportWorkService, SafeSwitchProcessor] })
class SafeSwitchModule {}

const __B0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('B0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: switch-safe');
})();
void __B0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
